Official code/data landing reference. Download page says use official source and accept license agreement.

compatibility.fit: Yes in principle for row-level click/engagement classification using observed interaction plus true negatives and numeric/categorical context; no sequence/RNN required. Must avoid post-outcome features and use grouped/chronological split appropriate to row semantics.
compatibility.task_limit: It is a logged recommendation dataset; pointwise response classification does not itself establish counterfactual ranking accuracy.

rights_and_access.rights: Fails user requirement: source grants research-purpose use and points to terms/license agreement; paper identifies CC BY-NC 4.0, which is noncommercial, not unrestricted open reuse.
rights_and_access.access: Official site directs users to terms before download; endpoint was not independently payload-verified this turn. Classify as terms-gated, not anonymous/no-gate.

full_batch.architecture: five hidden layers of width 512, float32
full_batch.result: Fails full-batch capacity by hidden activations alone; excludes input, gradients, parameters, optimizer state and workspace.

difficulty: No pilot run: rights/access and full-batch gates fail before difficulty screening.
decision: CROSS OUT all four scenarios from this suite under current constraints.
limitations: No scenario-specific row counts or checksums were obtained because the official payload route timed out and terms gate applies.
A hypothetical licensed subset/streamed-minibatch experiment would violate current no-gate and full-training-batch requirements.
No MLP accuracy/headroom conclusion is claimed.
